tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, nav bars and inputs. The default ground for content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: segmented-control track, meter track, input fill on canvas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons). 3:1 on surface and canvas in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, units, inactive nav labels. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Spruce. Fill of the primary button, selected states, active nav, focus of attention. As a mark it holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary controls.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the selected nav item, selected chips and on-track states.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Spruce as text: links and selected labels on surface or primary-soft.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The "now" signal: today marker, current time, the one thing due next. A fill only, never text; on light surfaces it needs on-marigold content inside it.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a marigold fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on canvas and surface in every theme.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, overspent budgets. Text on surface or danger-soft; fill of the danger button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error notices and over-budget meters.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention without failure: budget near its limit, backup overdue. Text on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning notices.

tokens.name: finance
tokens.usage: Finance module hue: its icon tile, chart line and tag. Text on surface, canvas or finance-soft.

tokens.name: finance-soft
tokens.usage: Finance tag and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: fitness
tokens.usage: Fitness module hue: icon tile, chart line, tag. Text on surface, canvas or fitness-soft.

tokens.name: fitness-soft
tokens.usage: Fitness tag and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: nutrition
tokens.usage: Nutrition module hue: icon tile, chart line, tag. Text on surface, canvas or nutrition-soft.

tokens.name: nutrition-soft
tokens.usage: Nutrition tag and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: health
tokens.usage: Health module hue: icon tile, chart line, tag. Text on surface, canvas or health-soft.

tokens.name: health-soft
tokens.usage: Health tag and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: routines
tokens.usage: Routines, goals and reminders hue. Text on surface, canvas or routines-soft.

tokens.name: routines-soft
tokens.usage: Routines tag and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. An alias of primary-text.

families.display: "Newsreader Variable", Newsreader, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif
families.sans: "Instrument Sans Variable", "Instrument Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Wall-display date and clock. Wall theme only.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page title at tablet and desktop widths ("Today", "Finance").

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Page title on phones; weekly-review section openers.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles, empty-state headings.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Card titles and section headings inside a page.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Weekly-review prose and onboarding copy; also body on the wall display.
styles.sample: You trained three times and stayed under your grocery budget.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and every input value (16px stops iOS zoom).
styles.sample: Breakfast is planned; lunch still needs a recipe.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary lines in rows and cards, hints under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and nav labels, field labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above a group of cards. Uppercase.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The single headline figure of a signal card or the review. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Secondary figures: macros remaining, weight, sets done.

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: Amounts in list rows, meter readouts.

styles.name: unit
styles.usage: Units and codes next to a figure: kg, kcal, EUR, bpm.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding block; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; card padding on phones; gap between stacked cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at tablet width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gutter at tablet width; gap between cards from tablet up.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gutter on desktop; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between the page title and the first section on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Wall-display gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding of the wall display.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, meter bars, checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented-control thumbs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs; wall-display cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch tracks, avatar, the today marker.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas in light theme. Dark themes rely on surface contrast and a line border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, toasts and menus that float above content.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, phone and desktop alike.

tokens.name: target-touch
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on touch devices and of quick actions.

tokens.name: target-wall
tokens.usage: Hit area on the wall display, operated at arm's length.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Phone tab bar, plus the bottom safe-area inset.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Tablet navigation rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content on desktop, centred in the remaining space.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for prose (weekly review, onboarding).

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: At and above: tablet layout with a navigation rail and a two-column signal grid.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: At and above: desktop layout with a sidebar, a content column and an action rail.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: At and above: the action rail widens and the signal grid may go to three columns.
